# Intervue

> > Intervue is an interview-as-a-service platform offering on-demand technical interviews, coding assessments, and system design evaluations with real-time collaboration tools.

Intervue provides comprehensive hiring solutions including technical screening, mock interviews with FAANG engineers, and analytics dashboards. The platform supports multiple programming languages (TypeScript, Java, React, Vue, C++, Python) and specializes in remote technical recruitment with real-time code sharing and collaboration features.

## Core Interview Products

- [Technical Interview Mastery | Intervue.io Products](https://www.intervue.io/products/on-demand/technical-interviews): On-demand technical interviews with Java, React, Vue support
- [Create new interview | Intervue](https://www.intervue.io/create-interview): Interview creation tool supporting multiple coding languages
- [System Design Interview Platform | Intervue.io](https://www.intervue.io/solutions/system-design-interviews): System design interviews with whiteboarding and real-time collaboration
- [Share Typescript code in real-time with developers in your browser | Intervue](https://www.intervue.io/typescript): Real-time TypeScript code sharing for browser-based developer interviews
- [Project Management Solutions - Intervue](https://www.intervue.io/products/projects): Real-world coding project assessments and technical evaluation tools

## Solutions & Services

- [Hiring Analytics Dashboard | Intervue.io Solutions](https://www.intervue.io/solutions/hiring-analytics): Data-driven hiring analytics dashboard for recruitment optimization
- [Schedule mock interviews with engineers from FAANG](https://www.intervue.io/solutions/mock-interviews): Free mock interviews with FAANG engineers for tech job preparation
- [Interview as a Service for BI Developer](https://www.intervue.io/interviews-for-business-intelligence-mid-senior): Interview-as-a-service for mid-senior Business Intelligence developers
